title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 138 (Whiteswan Forest Service Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Whiteswan Forest Service Road
138 That portion of M.U. 4-24 within 50 m of either side of the Whiteswan Forest Service Road from Inlet Creek Campground to the junction with the White-Moscow Forest Service Road. [en. B.C. Reg. 130/2016, App. 1, s. 4.]
